# `icon`

Helper: `ico(name, { size, tone })`  
Kit (`src/ui`): icon (`icons.tsx`) · status: src/ui  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaIcon` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Material Symbols Outlined glyph by name.

## Variants

- Size 16, 20, 24, 32
- Tone like text

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

ink-soft (default), the text tones

## Do

- Pair an icon-only control with an accessible name

## Don't

- A wrong name shows as text; `check` reports it (`badIcons`)
- Do not use emoji as icons

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Inline. The kit uses its own SVG set (`icons.tsx`).

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Inline. Material Symbols Outlined name; a wrong name shows as text and `check` reports `badIcons`
